title: Featured trombone solos and the clique in Armstrong's band
summary: He is featured on trombone and radio broadcasts until the clique of New Orleans men turns on him.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: How about trombone, were you featured on trombone at all?
I was featured quite a bit.
You played a little something on some of these things.
Do you have that record, I've got a list of famous trombones; do you have that?
Famous trombones?
Trombone solos.
No, I don't think so.
I've got it. In that it's got my solo with--Dan's got this one--of St. Louis Blues.
With Louie?
With Louie.
That was from off the air though?
That was taken off the air.
Oh, I heard that one. That's on Fleischman's Yeast, the Rudy Vallee--
No, no, it was on the Norge.
Norge frigidaire.
The Mills Brothers was on there too.
Yeah, I've got all that.
What I'm saying is, in other words, he did feature you playing, there's no question--
He featured me quite a bit until--
Until the Funny Horn thing.
Yeah, until the click got on me on that.
